title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Response Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, full solution test, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9464 provisioning response-policy surface.
scope: This verification covers CFG_REQUEST support advertisements, IPv4/IPv6 support indication, zero-length requests without specific resolvers, specific suggested resolver requests, optional request digest hash lists, duplicate-identical request handling, repeated-attribute discard threshold behavior, CFG_REPLY configuration selection, at-least-one-address enforcement, `alpn` preference, responder ability to ignore suggested values, multiple reply attributes, service-priority ordering, and optional CFG_REPLY digest information.
preconditions: The RFC 9464 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9464.json`.
The RFC 9464 response policy remains a pure value-selection layer and does not implement an IKEv2 session.
expected_result: The focused provisioning responder tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9464 artifacts, generated triage reflects the response-policy slice, diff hygiene passes, and the full solution test suite remains green.
status_summary: The RFC 9464 encrypted DNS provisioning response-policy floor is trace-owned and verified. RFC 7296 notify integration, full IKEv2 exchange behavior, resolver provisioning, and certificate validation remain future work.
